title: Reproducibility Report for SC25 Paper Sparsified Preconditioned Conjugate Gradient Solver on GPUs
problem: Artifact reproducibility verification for SC25 paper on GPU-accelerated sparse linear solvers
motivation: Reproducibility initiative ensures scientific findings can be independently verified and artifacts are usable by community
method: They obtained the GPU sparse linear solver code from the paper and ran it on their own hardware, following the SC25 Reproducibility Committee's standard verification procedures. They measured whether the code actually achieved the speedups and produced the numerical results that the paper claimed, and documented how their independent results compared.
key_novelty: This independently verifies that the Sparsified Preconditioned Conjugate Gradient Solver on GPUs actually achieves the performance improvements reported in the original paper.
contributions: Independent verification of Sparsified PCG Solver implementation
limitations: Reproducibility report only; refer to original paper for technical details
